description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/ChannelListing/getCategoryInfo. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the GET get category info operation in published product creation and optimization. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the get category info operation for published product creation and optimization. Input: [FromQuery] id: string. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the get category info operation. Search terms: channellisting getcategoryinfo. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.
